decisions.question: d3d11.sync.cpu=0 global strategy
decisions.notes: All hardware ships with sync.cpu=0 by default. If user reports tearing, manual fallback.

decisions.question: Fallback path for tearing users
decisions.notes: Settings > Advanced tab: GPU sync toggle. Uses _player.setProperty('d3d11.sync.cpu', '0'/'1') for hot-switch.

decisions.question: Hot-switch vs restart
decisions.notes: Toggle changes d3d11.sync.cpu at runtime via setProperty. No restart needed.

decisions.question: Default value for GPU sync toggle
decisions.notes: sync.cpu=1 by default (safe). User enables sync.cpu=0 for performance. Conservative approach.

decisions.question: Settings tab placement
decisions.notes: Place in Advanced tab to avoid cluttering Video settings.

decisions.question: Toggle label style
decisions.notes: 'GPU sync' with tooltip explanation. Technical users understand.

accumulated_decisions.tearing_strategy: Ship globally with sync.cpu=0, runtime toggle in Settings > Advanced for fallback
